terms.comment: The one God, and, with a small letter, any god; the gods are dī (also deī). The vocative is Deus (Deus, Deus meus, Ps. 62 (63), 2). Deō grātiās, thank God; Deō volente, God willing (Traupman).

phrases.latin: In prīncipiō creāvit Deus caelum et terram.
phrases.english: In the beginning God created heaven and earth.
